name: DatawiseAgent-benchmarkdata
description:
📊 DatawiseAgent-BenchmarkData
Benchmark datasets organized from:

InfiAgentBench
MatplotBench
DSBench

This repository provides the benchmark data used in the experiments of DatawiseAgent, and can also serve as evaluation datasets for other data science agents.
reputation: Provided and used by the DatawiseAgent authors and available on Hugging Face; useful to the data-science-agent community but not broadly standardized yet.
